# Apple
> Apple designs consumer hardware, software, services, and support resources across devices, entertainment, and developer platforms.

Apple’s web presence spans product overviews, online shopping, technical support, developer documentation, and service ecosystems for customers and developers.

## Products
- [Mac](https://www.apple.com/mac/): Overview of Mac laptops, desktops, features, and platform capabilities.
- [iPad](https://www.apple.com/ipad/): Overview of iPad models, accessories, and productivity features.
- [iPhone](https://www.apple.com/iphone/): Overview of iPhone models, features, and comparison information.
- [Apple Watch](https://www.apple.com/watch/): Overview of Apple Watch models, health features, and bands.
- [Apple Vision Pro](https://www.apple.com/apple-vision-pro/): Overview of Apple’s spatial computing headset and platform experience.
- [AirPods](https://www.apple.com/airpods/): Overview of AirPods models, audio features, and comparisons.
- [TV & Home](https://www.apple.com/tv-home/): Overview of Apple TV, HomePod, and smart home products.
- [Accessories](https://www.apple.com/us/shop/goto/buy_accessories): Shop for Apple and third-party accessories by product category.

## Store
- [Apple Store](https://www.apple.com/us/shop/goto/store): Entry point for Apple’s online store and product purchasing.
- [Mac Store](https://www.apple.com/us/shop/goto/buy_mac): Shop Mac models, configurations, and related accessories.
- [iPad Store](https://www.apple.com/us/shop/goto/buy_ipad): Shop iPad models, configurations, and compatible accessories.
- [iPhone Store](https://www.apple.com/us/shop/goto/buy_iphone): Shop iPhone models, carrier options, and trade-in offers.
- [Apple Watch Store](https://www.apple.com/us/shop/goto/buy_watch): Shop Apple Watch models, cases, and bands.
- [AirPods Store](https://www.apple.com/us/shop/goto/buy_airpods): Shop AirPods models and audio accessories.
- [TV & Home Store](https://www.apple.com/us/shop/goto/buy_tv): Shop Apple TV, HomePod, and home accessories.

## Services
- [Apple TV+](https://www.apple.com/apple-tv-plus/): Streaming service for Apple Original series, films, and events.
- [Apple Music](https://www.apple.com/apple-music/): Music streaming service with catalog access and subscription plans.
- [Apple Arcade](https://www.apple.com/apple-arcade/): Game subscription service for Apple devices and family sharing.
- [Apple Fitness+](https://www.apple.com/apple-fitness-plus/): Guided workout and wellness subscription service for Apple users.
- [Apple News+](https://www.apple.com/apple-news/): News and magazine subscription service with curated editorial content.
- [Apple Podcasts](https://www.apple.com/apple-podcasts/): Podcast listening platform and service overview.
- [Apple Books](https://www.apple.com/apple-books/): Ebook and audiobook reading platform for Apple devices.
- [iCloud](https://www.apple.com/icloud/): Cloud storage, sync, backup, and privacy-focused account services.

## Entertainment
- [Entertainment](https://www.apple.com/entertainment/): Hub for Apple’s media, streaming, and subscription services.
- [Apple TV App](https://www.apple.com/apple-tv-app/): Unified app for watching TV, movies, and sports content.
- [Apple One](https://www.apple.com/apple-one/): Bundle combining multiple Apple subscription services into one plan.
- [Apple Music Classical](https://www.apple.com/apple-music-classical/): Classical music streaming app and catalog overview.
- [MLS Season Pass](https://www.apple.com/apple-tv-plus/mls-season-pass/): Subscription access to Major League Soccer streaming coverage.

## Support
- [Apple Support](https://support.apple.com/?cid=gn-ols-home-hp-tab): Main support portal for products, services, and troubleshooting.
- [iPhone Support](https://support.apple.com/iphone): Help articles, setup guidance, and repair options for iPhone.
- [Mac Support](https://support.apple.com/mac): Help articles, setup guidance, and repair options for Mac.
- [iPad Support](https://support.apple.com/ipad): Help articles, setup guidance, and repair options for iPad.
- [Watch Support](https://support.apple.com/watch): Help articles, setup guidance, and repair options for Apple Watch.
- [AirPods Support](https://support.apple.com/airpods): Help articles and troubleshooting guidance for AirPods.
- [Apple ID Support](https://support.apple.com/apple-id): Account, sign-in, security, and recovery help for Apple ID.
- [Billing & Subscriptions Support](https://support.apple.com/billing): Help with purchases, billing issues, and subscriptions.

## Developer
- [Apple Developer](https://developer.apple.com/): Central hub for Apple platform development resources and programs.
- [Documentation](https://developer.apple.com/documentation/): API documentation for Apple frameworks, tools, and platforms.
- [Xcode](https://developer.apple.com/xcode/): IDE overview, tools, and resources for Apple app development.
- [Swift](https://developer.apple.com/swift/): Swift language resources, guides, and ecosystem information.
- [Design](https://developer.apple.com/design/): Human interface guidance, design resources, and UI principles.
- [App Store Connect](https://developer.apple.com/app-store-connect/): Tools for managing apps, metadata, and distribution workflows.
- [TestFlight](https://developer.apple.com/testflight/): Beta testing platform for distributing pre-release app builds.
- [SF Symbols](https://developer.apple.com/sf-symbols/): Iconography system and resources for Apple platform interfaces.

## Platform Documentation
- [iOS](https://developer.apple.com/ios/): Platform overview and development resources for iPhone applications.
- [iPadOS](https://developer.apple.com/ipados/): Platform overview and development resources for iPad applications.
- [macOS](https://developer.apple.com/macos/): Platform overview and development resources for Mac applications.
- [watchOS](https://developer.apple.com/watchos/): Platform overview and development resources for Apple Watch apps.
- [tvOS](https://developer.apple.com/tvos/): Platform overview and development resources for Apple TV apps.
- [visionOS](https://developer.apple.com/visionos/): Platform overview and development resources for spatial computing apps.

## Business and Education
- [Business](https://www.apple.com/business/): Apple products, deployment, and support solutions for organizations.
- [Education](https://www.apple.com/education/): Apple products, programs, and resources for schools and learning.
- [Retail](https://www.apple.com/retail/): Apple Store locations, services, sessions, and shopping support.
- [Trade In](https://www.apple.com/shop/trade-in): Device trade-in program and credit eligibility information.
- [Financing](https://www.apple.com/shop/browse/financing): Payment plans, installment options, and financing details.

## Company
- [Newsroom](https://www.apple.com/newsroom/): Official press releases, announcements, and corporate news updates.
- [Leadership](https://www.apple.com/leadership/): Profiles of Apple’s executive leadership team.
- [Values](https://www.apple.com/values/): Corporate values covering accessibility, privacy, environment, and inclusion.
- [Environment](https://www.apple.com/environment/): Sustainability goals, reporting, and environmental initiatives.
- [Privacy](https://www.apple.com/privacy/): Privacy principles, controls, and product privacy information.
- [Accessibility](https://www.apple.com/accessibility/): Accessibility features and inclusive design across Apple products.
